safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a cough without sputum production.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions cough but does not document the Gold fact that there is no sputum production.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the cough is non-productive can slightly affect assessment of infectious vs inflammatory causes and decisions about antibiotics, but it is unlikely to materially change management in an asthma exacerbation without other red flags.
